plotSections.title: Fused lantern-staff
bullets: The lantern and staff have fused. The same incantation reproducibly blinds people who look at it; Sylan avoided the effect by not looking.
While others were blinded, Ord saw a grayscale ethereal scene and an evocation aura, and he noticed spirits attached to Sylan.
Gerk was blinded even though he says he was off to the side and is not sure he was looking at the lantern.

plotSections.title: Six New Navel spirits
bullets: When Sylan took the staff to help Ord against the spirits, he could see them too. A black pillar rose and the spirits were drawn into Sylan, not into the staff.
All six are with Sylan again. He identifies them as people of New Navel with gripes and unfinished business there, and he may try to speak with them in his own realm.
Sylan frames a possible split in the item: a blinding effect with Ord, and spirit-gathering when he uses his darker inclination.

plotSections.title: Walker returns
bullets: Walker flies back in. Sylan asks if he is alive and still their friend; Walker answers, "Why wouldn't I be here?"

chronologicalEvents: 1. Sylan reports that another use of the lantern and staff fused them, and that the blinding effect still works.
2. Gerk says the test blinded him again even though he was nearby doing his own thing and is unsure whether he looked at the lantern. Sylan was able to ignore it by not looking.
3. Ord says he used the same incantation. It reliably blinds onlookers, shows him a grayscale ethereal view with an evocation aura, and reveals spirits attached to Sylan.
4. Sylan says those spirits seem to be people of New Navel. When he grabbed the staff, a black pillar shot up and the spirits were pulled into him. All six are with him again.
5. Sylan suspects he might converse with them in his realm and that their unfinished business is with people in New Navel.
6. Sylan calls Gerk a strong Karnak Mar, an orc term the table struggles to remember, while they joke about investigating the spirits.
7. Walker flaps back in. Asked if he is alive and still their friend, he says, "Why wouldn't I be here?"

Fused lantern-staff.existing: Fused lantern and staff that reveals the Ethereal Plane and draws nearby spirits when the active staff is held.
notes: Another use fused the lantern and staff.
The same incantation reproducibly blinds people who look at it. Not looking let Sylan ignore the effect.
Ord reads an evocation aura. While others are blinded he sees a grayscale ethereal view and the spirits on Sylan.
Sylan holding it raised a black pillar and drew the spirits into Sylan rather than into the staff.
Sylan suggests the blind effect pairs with Ord, while his own use gathers spirits.

Ord.existing: Dragonborn paladin and Gatekeeper of Feldspar.
notes: Used the same incantation as before and confirmed the blinding effect is reproducible.
While others were blinded, saw into the ethereal plane in grayscale, read an evocation aura, and saw spirits attached to Sylan.

Sylan.existing: Half-elf rogue and Gilbrick Gatekeeper, with a lantern-staff and a bond to spirits.
notes: Avoided the lantern's blindness by not looking at it.
Grabbing the staff let him see the spirits; the black pillar rose and all six were drawn back into him.
Says they seem to be New Navel people with gripes there. He may be able to converse with them in his realm, and he is considering looking into that unfinished business.
Sees a possible division of the fused item: blinding for Ord, spirit-gathering for himself.
quotesThemes: Suspects that going to his realm might let him converse with the six spirits, but he is not sure.
openQuestions: Can Sylan converse with the six spirits if he goes to his realm?

Gerk.existing: Half-orc barbarian, Doorman, and Child of the Great Eldarin Tree.
notes: Was blinded by the lantern test again. He says he was apart from the others and does not know whether he was looking at it.
Sylan calls him a strong Karnak Mar. Gerk answers with "Shadows are lost you live" and says he is Sylan's "skullly."
personality: Objects to being cursed or haunted and treats the blinding as harassment.
openQuestions: Was Gerk looking at the lantern when he was blinded?

Walker.existing: Half-elf dragon rider and fighter bonded to Glimmen, Gatekeeper of The Reach.
notes: Flies back in while the others are planning.
Asked whether he is alive and still their friend, he answers, "Why wouldn't I be here?"
Six spirits attached to Sylan, identified only as members of New Navel.
Visible on the ethereal plane in grayscale when the fused lantern-staff blinds onlookers, and also visible to Sylan once he holds the staff.
Drawn into Sylan, not the staff, when the black pillar rises. All six are with him again.
They have gripes and potentially unfinished business with some people in New Navel. The party declines to describe them beyond that.
openQuestions: What unfinished business do the six New Navel spirits have?

Beacon of celestial darkness.existing: A column of felt darkness that rises while the active staff is held.
notes: When Sylan grabbed the staff, a black pillar shot up and the spirits began getting sucked into him.
Orc term Sylan settles on after guessing and after Dana says Paradox Mar. He applies it to Gerk as "a strong Karnak Mar."
Gerk's reply in that exchange is "Shadows are lost you live," and he calls himself Sylan's "skullly."
openQuestions: What does Karnak Mar mean, and is "skullly" the same term?

newTerms.name: Karnak Mar
notes: Orc term the table only half-remembers. Sylan applies it to Gerk. Nearby hears include Kreudabrak, Paradox Mar, and skullly.
